name: Sunjeongmanhwaga Neomu Eolyeowo!
source:
Yunjae possesses the body of a character in a romantic comic.
The character he possesses is a supporting character called Doyeong, the sickly brother of the story’s heroine, Dohui.
Doyeong, a victim of bullying, meets a tragic end and eventually commits suicide.
In order to survive, Yunjae tries to change the plot of the story…
Will he be able to go back to his original world?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2359570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
允宰拥有浪漫漫画中角色的身体。
他所扮演的角色是一个名叫道英的配角，他是故事中女主人公道熙体弱多病的弟弟。
道英是欺凌的受害者，结局悲惨，最终自杀。
为了生存，允宰试图改变故事的情节……
他还能回到原来的世界吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2359570/]Steam[/url]]
